messages:
nightly-bot: Nightly perf alert: us-east-1 nightly dashboard detected SLO drift on runtime batchers. p50 +22%, p95 +60% vs baseline. KV cache hit-rate down ~18%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/24673 :eyes:
elaine: Seeing this now, thanks. Any recent merges touching kernel-selector / batching heuristics? @rajesh
rajesh: Yup—merged PR 2453f9 (selector-epsilon-adjust) ~23:08 UTC last night. Perf CI showed a small bump in smoke (+15%) but not flagged then. Could be related.
matt: Profiler snapshot while replaying a failing trace shows selector picking stream-kernel-v2 for short sequences (~<100 tokens). That kernel has extra quant/packing overhead after the recent quant-path work. If epsilon widened, selector might prefer it.
ivy: Attaching a tiny flame snippet from the smoke replay:
```
stack: runtime::select_kernel -> stream_kernel_v2::dispatch (60%)
seq_len: 24
avg_overhead_ms: 2.8
```
perf-ci-bot: Perf CI: job/runtime-smoke/2467309001 failed threshold check (p95). Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/2467309001/profile.pb
elaine: Starting bisect across last 6 commits. Assigning @rajesh to lead bisect since it likely touches selector.
rajesh: Bisect result: commit abc123 (the epsilon adjust) is the first bad one. Reverting locally brings p95 back to baseline on smoke run.
matt: That aligns with the kernel pick shift. The selector cost-model weights + epsilon tweak seem to bias towards stream-kernel-v2 which is expensive for short sequences.
ivy: Quick local mitigation: pin short-seq threshold to 128 in runtime config and replayed the same trace -> p95 improved ~45%. Pushing a test patch to try that as a toggle.
sre-jordan: Holding the release window for affected clusters (us-east-1, us-west-2). Marking rollout as blocked until revert/mitigation lands :no_entry_sign:
rajesh: Created revert PR 2467312002-revert-selector-epsilon. Running perf CI against revert now. Patch is minimal (undo epsilon bump + small comment).
perf-ci-bot: CI update: revert PR 2467312002 passed runtime-smoke and regression suites. p95 reduced ~48% vs current main. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/2467312002/summary.json
elaine: Good. Plan: merge revert PR, trigger canary rollback tonight (canary window 03:00 UTC). @sre-jordan please coordinate rollback schedule. Add postmortem ticket after canary confirms.
matt: Follow-up: I'll add a unit/regression test to assert kernel preference for short sequences (so selector change can't drift without failing tests).
ivy: I'll open a ticket to track KV miss correlation—seems cache prefetch patterns changed when kernel preference shifted. Might be second-order effect.
rajesh: After revert lands I'll run a longer overnight replay to ensure no other regressions.
nightly-bot: Alert cleared: subsequent checks show p95 back within normal bounds after the revert. Will keep monitoring for 24h and escalate if it reappears.
elaine: Nice work everyone. Quick notes: - revert merged - canary scheduled - follow-up tests/ticket created. :thumbsup:
